'''''Victory of the Rebel Alliance''''' was a [[Propaganda/Legends|pro]]-[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created some [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted three [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] charging at full speed through a (presumably Imperial-owned) barricade towards the viewer during a firefight, with a downed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] on the lower left corner. It was sometimes released separately, although a [[multi-painting]] version combining it with its pro-Imperial counterpart, ''[[Triumph of the Galactic Empire]]'', ''[[Forces Under Siege]]'', did exist.

==Behind the scenes==
''Victory of the Rebel Alliance'' was awarded to players following the release of Game Update 15. It was a random selection between two paintings for players who reactivated their accounts between February 1 and March 1 (the other painting being ''Triumph of the Galactic Empire'', although players whose accounts were in good standing before February 1 and continued to be in good standing after March 1 were rewarded with both paintings via the multi-painting, as a way to gain both paintings as a bonus. It is the only known painting under the multi-painting category within the game.

The painting has a number of "modes" that can be accessed via the "painting controls" option in the radial menu. These modes are:

*Rebel Painting - shows the Victory of the Rebel Alliance painting.
*Imperial Painting - shows the Triumph of the Galactic Empire painting.
*Cycle Paintings - will automatically switch appearance between the two paintings on a timer.
*Reflect Planetary Control - will automatically switch the painting to show the winning faction in the Planetary Control Game for the current planet.
*Reflect Galactic Control - will automatically switch the painting to show the faction that controls the galaxy.
